limits: This is the historical public mainnet test vector shipped with NQC, not independent Census production evidence, a live-chain attestation or a new vulnerability.
The unmodified reader accepts four recorded noncanonical encodings. An own re-encode equality guard rejects these specific cases; general canonical or recursive RLP validation is not certified.
Only the two imported helper libraries execute. The Ethernaut game, levels, external contracts and deployment flows are not executed.
The earlier ethers, viem, EthereumJS and Geth comparison is read from its preserved archive, whose producer had uncommitted changes. These four producers are not rerun by this adapter.
The two new Solidity replays share one host and verified kit; independence means fresh build directories and an independent byte/field witness, not independently authenticated hosts.
steps: Create a private empty kit directory at a caller-chosen path.
Acquire the pinned solc and Forge release artifacts, verify each archive and executable digest, and retain their notices. No installer script is required.

Fetch each immutable source URL in sources (or git show catalog_revision:source_path from the verified source checkout), verify byte count/SHA256 and its recorded Git blob, and write the exact bytes at kit_path. The repository LICENSE is retained separately from the MIT file-level library headers.
The kit contains solc, forge, the two original Solidity libraries and the original repository notice. No npm package, forge-std, nested Git submodule, RPC endpoint or game installation is required.

Run superhunter.product_rlp_library_native.run(pathlib.Path(KIT)). Each invocation creates a fresh temporary build directory, derives its fixed harness from the immutable Census fixture, and runs six local Forge test methods offline.

The reconciler checks 78 raw ABI event payloads against independently encoded bytes, all header fields and the recorded four-producer historical comparison; it also checks the human-decoded event text against the same raw values.
